## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Narrow leadership and mixed internals confirm caution: Top performance concentrated in Tech (4/5 of leaders) while broad sector participation is weak, and multiple large-cap divergences warrant reduced conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND. Communication showing modest strength: GOOGL (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +3.88%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND. Financials steady: CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Discretionary lagging: TSLA (1W: -3.89% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, RCL (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare softening: LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY. Industrials weakening: BA (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND; SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND; MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND; ADBE (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +17.60%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -3.89% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION; ETN (1W: -3.92% | 1M: +4.36%) CORRECTION; RCL (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND; ROST (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -9.51%) BELOW TREND; XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated across consumer cyclicals and parts of energy.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: CRM (1W: +22.39%), NOW (1W: +12.63%), SLB (1W: +6.42%). Note MAJOR divergence across large caps (≥3 major names with conflicting 1W vs 1M) — treat moves as tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but leadership concentrated; CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +11.54%) ABOVE TREND. Tech showing strong top-end gains but internals are narrow; Sector breadth: Technology positive within 4/11 overall.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Stable-to-favorable: JPM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND, CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.85% | 1M: +4.38%) ABOVE TREND. Financials are participating but gains are modest; watch card/payments weakness in PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Cautionary; headline-driven moves with divergence. LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +5.29%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY. Sector showing dispersion and is among lagging sectors.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to proven ABOVE TREND large-caps (CRM, MSFT, ADBE) while reducing exposure to names showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND stress (PYPL, RCL, ROST). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and weak breadth; treat rallies as tactical and await broader participation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through on record quarter; MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND for continued momentum. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND — headline-driven downside; AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND — watch for semiconductor demand signals.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology — leaders could extend gains if breadth improves (currently narrow). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary & Healthcare — pockets of stress and headline risk are weighing on internals.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
CRM: monitor weekly support near recent breakout zone (use firm-specific levels). MSFT: watch sustainment above short-term pivot for ABOVE TREND continuation. PYPL: watch breakdown confirmation below recent lows as trigger for further downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
CRM (+65): CEO remarks and record quarter; price confirming (CRM 1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND — accumulation. MO (+75): deal-related upside; price confirming (MO 1W: +3.87% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment aligned. AMAT (+60): AI demand narrative; price diverging (AMAT 1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND — watch for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-80): legal settlement headline; price diverging (META 1W: +5.11% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND — distribution risk despite gains. PYPL (-55): takeover-drop headline; price confirming (PYPL 1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND. MS (-40): headline risk to mortgage exposure; monitor financials for spillover (MS not shown in detailed table but flagged in news).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. CRM and MSFT showing strength (CRM ABOVE TREND; MSFT ABOVE TREND). Key risk: narrow Tech leadership and multiple large-cap divergences (e.g., META news vs price, PYPL sharp sell-off) — monitor sentiment-driven flow for confirmation.
